The '''Duma of Ledostrov''' is the legislative and noble assembly of the [[Duchy of Ledostrov]].

== Foundation ==

The Duma was created by the [[Anavaisk-Novoanov Accords]] in 1352. It was formed after the noble council deposed an ineffective duke and elevated the [[Prince of Novoanov]] under the condition that a permanent decision-making body be created.

== Powers ==

The original Duma was made up of landed nobles owing allegiance to the duke. A simple majority was required for declarations of war, budget changes, and foreign treaties. A two-thirds majority was required to elect a new duke after a duke's death.

If the Duma could not reach a two-thirds majority, the eldest child of the previous duke was supposed to act as regent until a new duke could be elected.

== Crisis And Reform ==

By the twentieth century, the source describes the Duma as corrupt and paralyzed. The 1938 famine crisis and [[Battle of Lisebev]] exposed its inability to govern effectively. In 1942, the Duma could not elect a successor after the death of the [[Count of Litwaldov]], enabling the [[Pentarchy of Ledostrov]] to seize power.

After the fall of the Pentarchy, [[Reznikoff of Ledostrov]] expanded the Duma by appointing military loyalists to the upper house and creating a lower house elected by popular vote. The old source gives a later upper-house count of 141 and lower-house count of 315, but this draft treats those numbers as later-source detail pending date review.
